kinds.d: A stuffed pillow made to support the head in bed.
A pillow, often U-shaped or inflatable, made to support the head and neck while sitting in transit.
A shaped foam or inflatable cushion made to hold the body in a chosen position.

notes: Three old kinds kept with old sources; fills, firmness and shapes (orthopaedic, body pillow) recorded as types. Kept the two old travel-pillow models; no new makers added (no research).
